mon.li:
December on our lanes: plan before the holidays.

What our dispatch team is planning around this month:

1. Fewer working days. Public holidays fall on 9 Dec, 25–26 Dec and 1 Jan. Confirm loading and delivery dates early.
2. Rain on the TANZAM. TMA expects heavier rain until January around Iringa, Mbeya and Songwe. Build extra time into Zambia runs.
3. Year-end at Tunduma. Border queues usually grow near month-end. Reach Tunduma before 9pm with your CE 20 form ready.
4. Kurasini Logistics Park opens in January 2027, and container inspections begin moving out of Dar es Salaam port, starting with exports.

Which lane do you need in December? Tell us in the comments, or get a written quote in one working day: https://www.mamboleodistributors.co.tz/quote?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=lane-report

Where we cross the border.

The main border crossings for each country we serve from Dar es Salaam, Tanga and Mtwara ports:

• Zambia: Tunduma–Nakonde
• DR Congo: via Zambia, through Kasumbalesa
• Rwanda: Rusumo
• Burundi: Kabanga–Kobero
• Uganda: Mutukula
• Kenya: Namanga and Holili

Customs clearance stays with your clearing agent. We move the cargo: weighed before it leaves, GPS-tracked, one dispatch contact.

Which country are you shipping to? Tell us in the comments, or get a written quote: https://www.mamboleodistributors.co.tz/quote?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=lanes

20 ft or 40 ft: which container fits your cargo?

• 20 ft: about 6 m long, about 33 m³. Often used for heavy, dense cargo.
• 40 ft: about 12 m long, about 67 m³. Often used for lighter, bulky cargo.

We move both on flatbed trailers, collected from Dar es Salaam, Tanga and Mtwara ports.

Not sure which you need? Send us the cargo, weight and volume, and we'll advise: https://www.mamboleodistributors.co.tz/quote?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=container-guide
